headline: Saber denies replacing Rideshare Stimulator's writers with ChatGPT
summary: Saber CEO Matthew Karch denies replacing writers with AI for 'Rideshare Stimulator'. Former lead writer Stella Sacco publicly claims she was replaced by ChatGPT. The controversy highlights ongoing debates about AI's role in creative industries.

headline: Xbox Elite 3 prototype pad leaks with tiny built-in screen
summary: Photos of a prototype Xbox Elite Series 3 controller have leaked online. The leaked pad features a distinctive tiny built-in screen. A Redditor claims to have purchased the unreleased controller for $200.

headline: New Sonos headphones hinted by FCC filing and CEO comments
summary: An FCC filing by Sonos Inc. reveals details for upcoming wireless headphones (model S52A). Sonos CEO Tom Conrad previously hinted at a successor to the Sonos Ace headphones. New Sonos headphones are expected to launch sometime this fall.

headline: ChatGPT and Gemini both hit 1 billion monthly active users
summary: Google's Gemini AI has reached 1 billion monthly active users, becoming Google's fastest-growing product. OpenAI's ChatGPT also recently surpassed the 1 billion user milestone. This marks a significant achievement for both leading AI platforms.

headline: Zack Snyder returns to Warner Bros. lot, sparking speculation
summary: Director Zack Snyder made a surprise visit to the Warner Bros. lot. His return comes years after his controversial exit from the DCEU. The visit has ignited speculation about his future projects with the studio.

headline: Ecoflow River 3 Plus power station now 50% off, just $139
summary: The Ecoflow River 3 Plus Power Station is currently available for $139. This represents a 50% discount from its usual retail price of $280. The deal is on a Costco exclusive product featuring a detachable power bank.

headline: Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level available for under $30
summary: The Fanttik D2 Pocket Green Laser Level is now priced below $30. It offers a modern alternative to traditional bubble levels for accuracy. This deal provides an affordable tool for precise leveling tasks.

headline: JSAUX Screen Protector for Nintendo Switch 2 costs only $7
summary: A JSAUX screen protector for the Nintendo Switch 2 is available for just $7. The pack includes three protectors, offering backup in case of application errors. It provides affordable protection for the console's screen.

headline: Woman assaulted by double murderer criticizes police for repeat attacks
summary: A woman assaulted by Simon Levy criticizes police handling of the serial sex offender. Levy went on to murder two women and rape a third after being left free. She claims disastrous decisions by authorities led to his subsequent crimes.

headline: UK faces new heat spike as summer weather records continue to break
summary: The UK is set to experience another heat spike, breaking more weather records. The number of days above 30C this summer has already surpassed previous tallies. This ongoing heatwave highlights a significant trend in extreme weather.

headline: Police chiefs urge PM to block early release of PC Harper's killers
summary: Police chiefs are calling on the Prime Minister to prevent the early release of PC Andrew Harper's killers. Their intervention follows Andy Burnham's confidence in blocking the release. The case remains highly sensitive and a point of public and political debate.

headline: UK to witness best solar eclipse since 1999, Europe-wide event
summary: The UK is poised to experience its most significant solar eclipse since 1999. Up to 96% of the Sun will be obscured by the Moon across the UK. Parts of Spain, Greenland, Iceland, Portugal, and Russia will see a total eclipse.
